question: In which year was a new Constitution adopted in Sri Lanka creating the 'Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1978**__.

__
 
• **In 1978 a new Constitution was adopted in Sri Lanka creating the 'Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka'.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1833, the British took complete control of the island of Ceylon.
 
• On 16 May 1972, Ceylon became the Republic of Sri Lanka.
 
• The new constitution was adopted, creating the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on 31 August 1978.
 
• In 1987, the 14th amendment was passed with the creation of provincial councils in Tamil areas and more regional autonomy.
